Set up the objects a HowMaHiCo report works on

Source: R/report-setup.R
report_setup.Rd

The setup step shared by the focused report templates (01_mhc_overview, 02_prot_all, 03_lcms_qc, 04_pepchem, 05_quant_stats), as an ordinary function so that a report can be run, chunk by chunk, outside a knit. It derives the peptide-length window and palette, the output folders, loads (or builds) pep_all, and derives pep_short plus the grouping vectors every section reuses, then assigns all of them into envir.

Usage

report_setup(params, envir = parent.frame())

Arguments

params

Named list of report parameters, normally from report_params() (inside a knit, the params rmarkdown provides). Missing optional entries (PepAllSource, InteractivePlots, ResultsOverwrite, Subset, ...) fall back to the template defaults.

envir

Environment the objects are assigned into. Defaults to the calling frame: the knit environment in a report, the global environment at the console.

Value

Invisibly, a named list of the assigned objects: shortpep_range, shortpep_palette, shortpep_colors, interactive_plots, subset, FolderResults, FolderFigures, result_prefix, file_rda, pep_all, pep_short, samples, conditions, n_conditions, bioreplicates, comp_condition, phis_nrow and phis_ncol.

Details

pep_all is obtained according to params$PepAllSource:

  • "cached" (default): load <FolderData>/<Subset>_pep_all.rda.

  • "rda": load the file given by params$PepAllFile.

  • "build": parse the raw search output with build_pep_all() (reading params$AnnotationFile from params$FolderDocumentation) and write the cache.

To step through a report interactively:

library(HowMaHiCo)
params <- report_params("03_lcms_qc", Subset = "dda_all", FolderData = "2_data")
report_setup(params)   # pep_all, pep_short, shortpep_range, ... now exist
# then run the remaining chunks of the skeleton (see get_report_template())

See also

report_params(), get_report_template(), run_howmahico_report()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
params <- report_params("01_mhc_overview", Subset = "dda_all",
                        FolderData = "2_data", FolderResults = "3_results")
report_setup(params)
table(pep_all$Condition)
} # }
